display.purpose: Homepage promise and A3S Test name only.

label.purpose: Commands, refs, revisions, coordinates, and digests.

shadows.name: surface-raised
shadows.purpose: The primary live Test Kit experience.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, selection, and copy-result state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a region.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: #1264ff; color: #fff; font: 720 13px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #084ed0; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(18,100,255,.28); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting route or reversible action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #bfd0e8; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #101827; font: 720 13px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #7ea1d8; color: #1264ff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(18,100,255,.28); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Evidence Chip
components.description: Reports a real verified or ready state.
components.css: .ds-evidence-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #b7dfd1; border-radius: 999px; background: #effaf6; color: #087353; font: 700 10px/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; }

components.name: Live Surface
components.description: The real Test Kit-powered interface proof.
components.css: .ds-live-surface { display: grid; gap: 10px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #bfd0e8; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: #101827; box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(36,76,137,.14); } .ds-live-surface strong { font: 720 20px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-live-surface span { color: #56657b; font: 700 11px/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Install Command
components.css: .ds-install-command { display: block; padding: 18px; border-radius: 9px; background: #0e1b35; color: #dce9ff; font: 600 12px/1.65 ui-monospace, monospace; }

narrative.overview: A bright A3S family surface makes the path from rendered interface to typed action, human authorization, and inspectable evidence visible before implementation detail.
keyCharacteristics: White and pale-blue operating surfaces with one decisive electric-blue field per viewport.
A real Test Kit-powered page experience as the primary visual proof.
Cool hairlines, compact controls, restrained blue-tinted elevation, and generous section spacing.

rules.name: The One Blue Field Rule
rules.body: One major blue region may carry a viewport; elsewhere blue is action and wayfinding.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace communicates data and protocol state, never general product personality.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Structural regions use a cool boundary; floating interfaces receive elevation.

dos: Do demonstrate rendered semantics, revision binding, coordinates, human review, and evidence with real product behavior.
Do keep Chinese and English content, routes, labels, and accessible names in parity.
donts: Don't invent repair success, customer evidence, benchmark results, or unsupported platform availability.
Don't replace the real Test Kit experience with a static illustration or fake overlay.
